name: kite_ly-mcp
description: Kite (Prodigi Group) (ecommerce suppliers): me, create_order, get_order, track. Every tool maps to a

platform_mcp_kite_ly_api_key_pair.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KITE_LY_API_KEY_PAIR
platform_mcp_kite_ly_api_key_pair.description: Your Kite API key and secret key joined by a colon, exactly as the Authorization header expects them: <public_key>:<secret_key> (dashboard > credentials). The secret key is required for order requests, which are then charged to the card on your Kite account; test-mode keys never create real products.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe lists one order ({meta{total_count}, objects[]}), which needs the key and secret.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Places a print order charged to the card on your Kite account (secret key in the Authorization header; live keys create and ship real products). `shipping_address` uses Kite's address keys {recipient_name, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, county_state, postcode, country_code (ISO-3, e.g. GBR)} plus `phone` (customer_phone, required by Kite) and `email` (customer_email); `items` are Kite jobs [{template_id, assets[image URLs], options, shipping_class}] - the shipping class is per job, so `shipping_option` is not sent. Answers {print_order_id}.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /v4.0/order/{order_id}: {order_id, status, dispatch_status (e.g. In Print Queue, Dispatched), time_submitted, time_processed, test_order, jobs[{job_id, status, shipped_time, template{id, name}}]}. No tracking number is documented on the order.

tools.name: track
tools.description: Per-job production status of the order (jobs[{job_id, status, shipped_time, template}]); carrier tracking numbers are not part of the documented response.
